# Financial Digital Twin

> An open-source governance workspace for financial institutions: understand issues, follow evidence, and record reviews. Includes a synthetic GitHub Pages demo and a connected development workspace backed by alert and audit services.

The public demo follows Northstar’s dollar payment decisions and a separate euro 30-day liquidity challenge and preserves the selected case and evidence trial in the URL. Connected reviews are persisted in PostgreSQL; linked alert evidence and explicit chain verification use the audit service and immudb. The connected runtime uses a configured development reviewer, not production end-user authentication. Acknowledgement and escalation do not resolve an issue or approve a policy exception. This is not a certified regulatory reporting product.

This file is an optional documentation index for readers and tools. It does not grant permissions, override user instructions, or guarantee discovery or indexing.

Published index: https://safetymp.github.io/Financial-Digital-Twin-Compliance/llms.txt
Source index: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SafetyMP/Financial-Digital-Twin-Compliance/main/llms.txt

## Start here

- [Interactive governance demo](https://safetymp.github.io/Financial-Digital-Twin-Compliance/): Replay the dollar settlement queue, check the euro coverage estimate, and compare the CFO’s pilot alternatives.
- [GOV-1042 technical inspector](https://safetymp.github.io/Financial-Digital-Twin-Compliance/workspace/): Payment replay, selected source dates, coverage calculation, timed packet trials and a local checksum.
- [Project overview](https://github.com/SafetyMP/Financial-Digital-Twin-Compliance/blob/main/README.md): Audience, capabilities, modes, and project navigation.
